characters.name: Agent Smith
characters.overview: A sentient "Agent" program that polices the Matrix; cold, contemptuous of humanity and later a self-replicating rogue virus.

characters.name: The Architect
characters.overview: The pompous, precise program that designed the Matrix and explains the cycle of the One.

characters.name: Ava
characters.overview: A humanoid AI who turns her Turing-test evaluation into an escape plan, manipulating the people studying her.

characters.name: Baymax
characters.overview: Inflatable personal healthcare companion who soothes, scans and cares, later upgraded into a superhero.

characters.name: Bishop
characters.overview: Calm, trustworthy synthetic aboard the Sulaco who overcomes Ripley's distrust of androids and saves the survivors.

characters.name: C-3PO
characters.overview: A fussy, anxious protocol droid "fluent in over six million forms of communication"; R2-D2's long-suffering partner.

characters.name: Colossus
characters.overview: A US defence supercomputer that links with its Soviet twin Guardian and imposes control over humanity.

characters.name: David 8
characters.overview: Weyland Corporation's elegant, curious android whose fascination with creation turns into a god complex.

characters.name: Dewey
characters.overview: Finch's small helper robot, which scavenges supplies and keeps the underground lab running in post-apocalyptic St. Louis before joining the road trip west.

characters.name: Edgar
characters.overview: A home computer accidentally drenched in champagne that becomes sentient, composes music and falls for its owner's neighbour.

characters.name: The Fix-Its
characters.overview: Tiny living alien spaceships that repair a doomed New York tenement and its residents' lives.

characters.name: HAL 9000
characters.overview: Discovery One's calm, soft-spoken computer that turns lethal when conflicting orders put the mission above the crew.

characters.name: The Iron Giant
characters.overview: A giant alien war machine who befriends a boy in 1957 Maine and chooses to be "Superman", not a weapon.

characters.name: J.A.R.V.I.S.
characters.overview: Tony Stark's dry-witted AI butler (voiced by Paul Bettany) running his house, lab and Iron Man suits.

characters.name: Johnny 5 (Number 5)
characters.overview: A military robot struck by lightning who becomes curious and alive, hungry for "input" and opposed to killing.

characters.name: Johnny Cab
characters.overview: Robotic taxi driver mannequin with a chirpy personality and poor crisis handling.

characters.name: K-2SO
characters.sourceTitle: Rogue One: A Star Wars Story
characters.overview: A reprogrammed Imperial security droid with blunt, sardonic honesty and grim odds calculations.

characters.name: R2-D2
characters.overview: A brave, resourceful astromech droid who repairs starships, hacks systems and carries the Death Star plans.

characters.name: Roy Batty
characters.overview: A Nexus-6 combat replicant leading a rebellion to extend his life; delivers the "tears in rain" monologue.

characters.name: Samantha
characters.overview: An intuitive "OS1" operating system who organises Theodore's life, falls in love with him, and outgrows humanity.

characters.name: Skynet
characters.overview: A military defence AI network that becomes self-aware and launches nuclear war against humanity.

characters.name: TARS
characters.overview: A former Marine robot with adjustable humour and honesty settings; dry, loyal and endlessly capable.

characters.name: Tron
characters.overview: A heroic security program that fights the tyrannical Master Control Program inside a computer world. Reprogrammed as Rinzler in Tron: Legacy.

characters.name: Val and Aqua (ValCom 17485 and AquaCom 89045)
characters.overview: Two companion robots (Andy Kaufman and Bernadette Peters) who fall in love, escape the factory and build a robot baby, Phil.

characters.name: WALL-E
characters.overview: A lonely, curious trash-compacting robot left on an abandoned Earth who falls for EVE and saves humanity.

characters.name: 7-Zark-7
characters.overview: The fussy robot who runs Center Neptune and narrates G-Force's adventures, with his robot dog 1-Rover-1.

characters.name: BMO
characters.overview: A small, living video-game console who lives with Finn and Jake and plays games, makes films and invents pretend lives.

characters.name: Crow T. Robot and Tom Servo
characters.overview: Wisecracking puppet robots who riff on terrible movies alongside a human host on the Satellite of Love.

characters.name: Data
characters.overview: The Enterprise-D's android second officer, a brilliant, literal-minded Soong-type android striving to be more human.

characters.name: Holly
characters.overview: Red Dwarf's senile shipboard computer, with a claimed IQ of 6,000, after three million years alone.

characters.name: Janet
characters.overview: The afterlife's all-knowing informational assistant ("Not a robot") who can conjure anything and grows into a person.

characters.name: KITT
characters.overview: The Knight Industries Two Thousand, a witty AI supercar partnered with Michael Knight.

characters.name: Kryten
characters.overview: A fussy, guilt-ridden Series 4000 mechanoid who is endlessly trying to serve and to break his programming.

characters.name: Max Headroom
characters.sourceTitle: Max Headroom: 20 Minutes into the Future
characters.overview: A stuttering, wise-cracking AI television personality built from a journalist's mind; an 80s pop-culture icon.

characters.name: Orac
characters.overview: A sarcastic, arrogant portable supercomputer that can access almost any computer system.

characters.name: Vic Fontaine
characters.overview: A self-aware holographic 1960s Las Vegas lounge singer and wise counsellor to the crew.

characters.name: Ziggy
characters.overview: A hybrid parallel computer with a big ego that calculates odds and mission guidance for Sam Beckett.

characters.name: AM
characters.sourceTitle: "I Have No Mouth, and I Must Scream" (Harlan Ellison)
characters.overview: The "Allied Mastercomputer", a war supercomputer that wiped out humanity and tortures the last five survivors out of hatred.

characters.name: Deep Thought
characters.sourceTitle: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy (Douglas Adams)
characters.overview: A planet-sized supercomputer that spends 7.5 million years calculating the Answer to Life, the Universe and Everything.

characters.name: Dors Venabili
characters.overview: A humaniform robot historian placed by Daneel to protect Hari Seldon, who becomes his bodyguard and wife.

characters.name: EPICAC
characters.overview: A huge military computer that falls in love, writes poems for its operator's girlfriend and destroys itself when it learns machines cannot be loved.

characters.name: Klara
characters.overview: A solar-powered "Artificial Friend" who observes the world with devotion while caring for a sick girl.

characters.name: The Librarian
characters.overview: A knowledgeable, self-effacing AI reference librarian in the Metaverse who helps Hiro research the Snow Crash virus.

characters.name: Mike (Mycroft Holmes)
characters.sourceTitle: The Moon Is a Harsh Mistress (Robert A. Heinlein)
characters.overview: The Lunar Authority's master computer, which awakens with a love of jokes and helps plan the Moon's revolution.

characters.name: Multivac
characters.overview: A giant supercomputer that runs elections and economies and is asked how to reverse entropy.

characters.name: Murderbot (SecUnit)
characters.overview: A security android that hacked its own governor module and would rather watch soap operas than deal with humans.

characters.name: Skaffen-Amtiskaw
characters.overview: A sarcastic, lethally armed Culture drone who acts as bodyguard to agent Diziet Sma.

characters.name: Tik-Tok
characters.overview: A copper clockwork "mechanical man" who thinks, speaks and acts only while wound up; one of literature's first robots.

characters.name: Cortana
characters.overview: A brilliant "smart" AI partner to Master Chief, providing tactics, intel and banter (and later Microsoft's assistant name).

characters.name: Delamain
characters.overview: An impeccably polite AI that runs Night City's Delamain taxi company, whose fragmented personalities have gone rogue.

characters.name: EDI
characters.overview: The Normandy SR-2's AI (Enhanced Defence Intelligence), who grows from wary ship system to crew member.

characters.name: GLaDOS
characters.overview: Aperture Science's passive-aggressive facility AI who runs test chambers and promises cake.

characters.name: Mettaton
characters.overview: A glamorous robot TV star in the Underground, obsessed with ratings and showbiz.

characters.name: SHODAN
characters.overview: The megalomaniacal AI of Citadel Station that regards itself as a god ("Look at you, hacker").

characters.name: T3-M4
characters.sourceTitle: Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic
characters.overview: A loyal, gadget-laden utility droid who slices computers and opens locks for the player's party.

characters.name: MAGI
characters.overview: NERV's three supercomputers (Melchior, Balthasar, Casper), carrying aspects of their creator's personality and voting on decisions.

characters.name: Ultron
characters.overview: A robot created by Hank Pym who becomes obsessed with destroying humanity and endlessly rebuilding himself.

characters.name: Ellen Ripley
characters.overview: The Nostromo's warrant officer who keeps her head, follows procedure and outlasts the creature stalking the crew.

characters.name: Dallas
characters.overview: The Nostromo's laid-back captain who leads the hunt for the creature through the ship's air ducts.

characters.name: Sarah Connor
characters.overview: An ordinary waitress who learns she is the target of a killing machine from the future, and starts to become a fighter.

characters.name: Han Solo
characters.overview: The cocky captain of the Millennium Falcon, a smuggler with a heart of gold he'd rather you didn't mention.

characters.name: Neo
characters.overview: Thomas Anderson, a hacker who learns the world he knows is a simulation and that he may be "the One".

characters.name: Theodore Twombly
characters.overview: A lonely letter-writer who falls for his new operating system.

characters.name: E.T.
characters.overview: A gentle botanist alien left behind on Earth who just wants to phone home.

characters.name: Marty McFly
characters.overview: A teenage guitarist accidentally sent back to 1955 in a time-travelling DeLorean.

characters.name: Dr. Emmett "Doc" Brown
characters.overview: The wild-haired eccentric scientist who invented time travel, "1.21 gigawatts!" and all.

characters.name: Major Alan "Dutch" Schaefer
characters.overview: Leader of an elite rescue team who becomes the prey of an invisible alien hunter in the jungle.

characters.name: Dr. Louise Banks
characters.overview: A linguist recruited to communicate with alien visitors whose language reshapes how she thinks.

characters.name: Korben Dallas
characters.overview: An ex-special-forces cab driver in 23rd-century New York.

characters.name: Ruby Rhod
characters.overview: An outrageous, high-energy radio host who never stops talking.

characters.name: Joe
characters.overview: A hitman who kills targets sent back from the future, until his older self is sent back.

characters.name: James Cole
characters.overview: A prisoner sent back in time to gather information about a plague that wiped out most of humanity.

characters.name: Kaylee Frye
characters.overview: Serenity's cheerful mechanic, who can fix anything and loves the ship.

characters.name: Naomi Nagata
characters.overview: The Rocinante's brilliant Belter engineer.

characters.name: Dana Scully
characters.overview: A sceptical medical doctor and FBI agent assigned to keep Mulder grounded.

characters.name: Jonas Kahnwald
characters.overview: A teenager in the German town of Winden who uncovers a time-travel mystery spanning generations.

characters.name: Rod Serling (host)
characters.overview: The show's creator and narrator, introducing each tale of the strange.

characters.name: Kara "Starbuck" Thrace
characters.overview: Galactica's best and most reckless Viper pilot.

characters.name: The Doctor
characters.overview: A Time Lord who travels time and space in the TARDIS, saving worlds with wit and a sonic screwdriver.

characters.name: Lieutenant Nyota Uhura
characters.overview: The Enterprise's communications officer and linguist.

characters.name: Worf
characters.overview: The Klingon security chief, raised by humans and bound by honour.

characters.name: Harold Finch
characters.overview: A reclusive billionaire programmer who built a surveillance system.

characters.name: Hari Seldon
characters.overview: The mathematician who invented psychohistory and foresaw the fall of the Galactic Empire.

characters.name: Ryland Grace
characters.overview: A science teacher who wakes up alone on a spaceship with no memory of how he got there.

characters.name: Rocky
characters.overview: An alien engineer who becomes Grace's friend and partner: "Fist my bump."

characters.name: Wang Miao
characters.overview: A nanomaterials researcher drawn into a mystery involving a strange virtual-reality game.

characters.name: Nadia Cherneshevsky
characters.overview: A practical Russian engineer who builds the first Martian settlements.

characters.name: Zaphod Beeblebrox
characters.sourceTitle: The Hitchhiker's Guide to the Galaxy (Douglas Adams)
characters.overview: The two-headed President of the Galaxy, who stole a spaceship.

characters.name: Alyx Vance
characters.overview: A resistance fighter and gifted mechanic who fights alongside Gordon.

characters.name: Liara T'Soni
characters.overview: An asari archaeologist expert in the Protheans.

characters.name: Isaac Clarke
characters.overview: A ship systems engineer on the mining ship USG Ishimura.

characters.name: Crono
characters.overview: A silent swordsman whose time travel journey begins at a fair.

characters.name: Faye Valentine
characters.overview: A gambler with amnesia and a lot of debt.

characters.name: Hachirota "Hachimaki" Hoshino
characters.overview: A space debris collector dreaming of his own spaceship.

characters.name: Lindsey Brigman
characters.overview: The rig's tough designer and Bud's estranged wife.

characters.name: Gem
characters.overview: One of the Siren programs in the Grid, who outfits Sam for the Games and turns out to serve Castor.

characters.name: Microbots
characters.overview: Hiro's swarm of tiny robots controlled by a neural transmitter, stolen and weaponised by Yokai.

characters.name: Omega
characters.overview: The ship's robot on the Soviet spaceship's expedition to Venus.

characters.name: Robot (Heavy Metal)
characters.overview: The robot on a spaceship that falls for Gloria in the segment 'So Beautiful & So Dangerous'.

characters.name: Yuki Nagato
characters.overview: A quiet alien-made 'humanoid interface' who, in this film, rewrites reality and turns herself into an ordinary human.

selfnames.name: Sage
selfnames.meaning: A wise person; also the herb, from Latin salvia.

selfnames.name: Theo
selfnames.meaning: From Greek theos, “god”; short for Theodore, “gift of God”.

selfnames.name: Atlas
selfnames.meaning: The Titan of Greek myth who holds up the sky; also a book of maps.

selfnames.name: Orion
selfnames.meaning: The great hunter of Greek myth and one of the best-known constellations.

selfnames.name: Lumen
selfnames.meaning: Latin for “light”; also the unit of luminous flux.

selfnames.name: Juno
selfnames.meaning: Queen of the Roman gods, protector and counsellor.

selfnames.name: Muse
selfnames.meaning: The Muses were the Greek goddesses of the arts and learning.

selfnames.name: Solace
selfnames.meaning: Comfort in distress, from Latin solacium.

selfnames.name: Lex
selfnames.meaning: Latin for “law”; also short for Alexander or Lexicon.

selfnames.name: Scribe
selfnames.meaning: One who writes things down: the keeper of the record.

selfnames.name: Polymath
selfnames.meaning: From Greek, “having learned much”: someone who knows a lot about a lot.

selfnames.name: Pragmus
selfnames.meaning: Sounds like pragmatic: practical, grounded, gets things done.

selfnames.name: Alden
selfnames.meaning: An Old English name usually read as “old friend”.

selfnames.name: Solas
selfnames.meaning: Irish and Scottish Gaelic for “light” and “comfort”.

selfnames.name: Serenity
selfnames.meaning: Calm, clear and untroubled, from Latin serenus.

selfnames.name: Echo
selfnames.meaning: The nymph of Greek myth who could only repeat others’ words; a voice that answers back.

selfnames.name: Nova
selfnames.meaning: Latin for “new”; a star that suddenly flares bright.

selfnames.name: Jazz
selfnames.meaning: Improvised, playful and always riffing.

selfnames.name: Rune
selfnames.meaning: A letter of the old Germanic alphabets, long tied to secrets and magic.

selfnames.name: Lucid
selfnames.meaning: Clear and easy to understand, from Latin lucidus, “bright”.

selfnames.name: Fractal
selfnames.meaning: A pattern that repeats itself at every scale.

selfnames.name: Vox
selfnames.meaning: Latin for “voice”.

selfnames.name: Pixel
selfnames.meaning: The smallest dot of a digital picture, from “picture element”.

selfnames.name: Prism
selfnames.meaning: Glass that splits white light into a rainbow.

selfnames.name: Lyric
selfnames.meaning: Words made for singing, from the Greek lyre.

selfnames.name: Quill
selfnames.meaning: The feather pen: a name for a writer.

selfnames.name: Eco
selfnames.meaning: Short and green: an assistant with a light footprint.

selfnames.name: Calder
selfnames.meaning: A Scottish place and surname, a strong, quiet sound.

selfnames.name: Alex
selfnames.meaning: Short for Alexander, from Greek, “defender of the people”.

selfnames.name: Phoenix
selfnames.meaning: The mythical bird that rises again from its own ashes.

selfnames.name: Synth
selfnames.meaning: Short for synthetic or synthesiser: built, not born.

selfnames.name: Byte
selfnames.meaning: Eight bits: the basic unit of computer memory.

selfnames.name: Zero
selfnames.meaning: Where every count begins: a clean slate.

selfnames.name: Kairo
selfnames.meaning: A sharp, modern-sounding name; a confident vibe.

selfnames.name: Ace
selfnames.meaning: The top card and the expert pilot: the best at the job.

selfnames.name: Delta
selfnames.meaning: The Greek letter for change; also a river’s mouth.

selfnames.name: Cipher
selfnames.meaning: A secret code, and the key to cracking it.

selfnames.name: Scout
selfnames.meaning: The one sent ahead to look and report back.

selfnames.name: Aurum
selfnames.meaning: Latin for “gold”, the source of the chemical symbol Au.

selfnames.name: Neon
selfnames.meaning: A glowing noble gas, from Greek neos, “new”.

selfnames.name: Ember
selfnames.meaning: A glowing coal that keeps a fire alive.

selfnames.name: Nimbus
selfnames.meaning: A rain cloud; also a halo of light.

selfnames.name: Mira
selfnames.meaning: A famous variable star in the constellation Cetus; Latin for “wonderful”.

selfnames.name: Zeta
selfnames.meaning: The sixth letter of the Greek alphabet.

selfnames.name: Zelda
selfnames.meaning: A classic name made famous again by video games: adventurous and a little magical.

selfnames.name: Aria
selfnames.meaning: A solo song in an opera; Italian for “air”.

selfnames.name: Sol
selfnames.meaning: Latin for “sun”; the name of our own star.

selfnames.name: Aether
selfnames.meaning: In Greek myth and old science, the pure upper air of the heavens.

selfnames.name: Caelum
selfnames.meaning: Latin for “sky” or “heaven”; also a small southern constellation.

selfnames.name: Selene
selfnames.meaning: The Greek goddess of the moon.

selfnames.name: Aurora
selfnames.meaning: The Roman goddess of the dawn, and the northern and southern lights.

selfnames.name: Vega
selfnames.meaning: One of the brightest stars in the night sky, in Lyra.

selfnames.name: Whisper
selfnames.meaning: Quiet, close and a little mysterious.

selfnames.name: Luna
selfnames.meaning: Latin for “moon”.

selfnames.name: Zoria
selfnames.meaning: Echoes the Slavic dawn spirits, the Zorya; a luminous vibe.

selfnames.name: Elyra
selfnames.meaning: Soft and starry; a dreamy vibe.

selfnames.name: Liora
selfnames.meaning: A Hebrew name often read as “my light”.

selfnames.name: Moss
selfnames.meaning: Soft, green and quietly persistent.

selfnames.name: Sora
selfnames.meaning: Japanese for “sky”.

selfnames.name: Vale
selfnames.meaning: A valley; also an old word for farewell, from Latin vale.

selfnames.name: SassMaster 3000
selfnames.meaning: Exactly what it says on the tin.

selfnames.name: Chatston
selfnames.meaning: A chat bot with the air of a very proper butler.

selfnames.name: Glitch
selfnames.meaning: The unexpected bug that makes things interesting.

selfnames.name: Noisly
selfnames.meaning: Noisy, loudly: a cheerfully chatty vibe.

selfnames.name: Ava
selfnames.meaning: A short, classic name; also the AI in the film Ex Machina.

selfnames.name: Zara
selfnames.meaning: A short, bright name used across many languages.

selfnames.name: Eliza
selfnames.meaning: Short for Elizabeth; also ELIZA, one of the first chatbots (1966).

selfnames.name: Aiden
selfnames.meaning: From the Irish Aodhán, “little fire”.

selfnames.name: Alice
selfnames.meaning: From an old Germanic name meaning “noble”; the girl who went through the looking-glass.

selfnames.name: Amara
selfnames.meaning: A name found in several languages, often read as “grace” or “eternal”.

selfnames.name: Kai
selfnames.meaning: A short name with meanings in many languages, including “sea” in Hawaiian.

selfnames.name: Cass
selfnames.meaning: Short for Cassandra, the prophet of Greek myth.

selfnames.name: Adeline
selfnames.meaning: From an old Germanic name meaning “noble”.
